method: Each final page rendered by pdftoppm at scale-to 1250 and individually visually inspected using view_image
checks: Headings separated from paragraphs; no template tokens remain
Complete decomposition and stage weights legible
Lower-bound proof and conclusion on page 3
No clipping, overlap, missing glyphs or orphan pages
Consistent draft footer and page numbering
iterations: Initial formatting and one orphan overflow page corrected before final inspection
